newsitem.title: TURKEY: Saudi Arabia buys 1.4 mln tonnes of barley - trade.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia buys 1.4 mln tonnes of barley - trade.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has bought about 1.4 million tonnes of barley for import from October to December, grain traders said on Monday.
Baring any last minute surprises a full written confirmation of the purchase was expected shortly, they said.
Saudi Arabia had tendered to import 1.72 million tonnes of barley.
Details of pricing were hard to pin down but appeared to be in a wide range of up to $12 per tonne, traders said.
One trader pegged the highest prices (with freight) at $156 to $158 per tonne with the lowest at around $146 per tonne.
Another thought the spread was narrower.
Most European fob values appear to be in the $130s, traders said.
As in the past, traders have been told they must pay penalties if deliveries are delayed.
